title: Beginner's Guide to scSimEvalStudio
text: scSimEvalStudio (version 0.99.4) point--click Shiny web app built make single-cell multiomics simulation benchmarking simple accessible—even brand new R. Instead writing scripts run metrics format dozens plots, scSimEvalStudio gives clean browser workspace can: Try 1-click example datasets immediately learn app works. Upload scRNA-seq, scATAC-seq, multiomics .rds datasets (SingleCellExperiment Seurat). Compare simulators visually easy 0 1 scale (1.0 = best match real dataset). Zoom, pan, customize, download 600 DPI figures, Excel workbooks, reproducible R scripts. Want full metric definitions, statistical details, R programming tutorials? underlying evaluation methods documented separately scSimEval Core Package Documentation. Overview 4 simple stages inside scSimEvalStudio: Load Data, Run Evaluation, Compare Rankings, Explore & Export Results.

what: 3. Step 2 — Load Data in the Data Hub Tab
title: Beginner's Guide to scSimEvalStudio
text: app opens, click Data Hub top bar. 4 easy options: Try 1-Click Example Dataset (Recommended Beginners) Choose included empirical benchmark—Rice Bud (6 simulators) Soybean Root (3 simulators)—populate every chart table seconds. Upload Single-Cell Data (scRNA-seq scATAC-seq) Upload real reference .rds file along one simulated .rds files. SingleCellExperiment Seurat .rds files accepted (Seurat objects converted automatically). files contain cell_type batch columns, extra clustering, batch, biological signal checks unlock automatically. Upload Multiomics Data (RNA + ATAC) Choose Paired (RNA ATAC measured cells) Unpaired (measured separate cells tissue), upload .rds files, click Run. Reload Previously Saved Results (.rds .csv) Already ran benchmark earlier? Upload saved .rds archive .csv table view customize plots instantly without waiting calculations run . Tip Large Datasets: configuring files Data Hub, click Download R Script save ready--run script can execute lab workstation HPC server, upload saved .rds output back Data Hub explore plots.

what: 4. Step 3 — Compare Simulators at a Glance
title: Beginner's Guide to scSimEvalStudio
text: Open Comparative Bubble Matrix tab see simulators rank: Read Scores: Every metric shown simple 0.0 1.0 scale, closer 1.0 means closer match real biological dataset. Comparative Bubble Matrix Figure: left bars show overall category averages; right grid shows individual metrics circles. Bigger circles = better scores, bold black outline highlights top-performing simulator metric. Fidelity Leaderboard: Switch second sub-tab clean, sortable ranking table can download .csv file. Easy Filtering: Use sidebar controls filter dataset, modality (scRNA-seq, scATAC-seq, Combined), specific simulators, specific categories, adjust figure width height downloading.

text: Launches companion Shiny web application bundled scSimEvalStudio. Provides graphical interface upload SingleCellExperiment biological reference simulated datasets (scRNA-seq, scATAC-seq, paired unpaired multiomics), execute 56-measure evaluation suite across 8 canonical categories, explore diagnostic figures interactively, export publication-quality figures, standalone HPC R scripts, Excel/PDF reports.

title: Launch Interactive scSimEval Benchmarking Studio — launch_scSimEval_app
code: launch_scSimEval_app(   port = NULL,   host = "127.0.0.1",   launch.browser = interactive(),   maxRequestSize = 10 * 1024^3 )

title: Launch Interactive scSimEval Benchmarking Studio — launch_scSimEval_app
text: port Optional port number local web server. Default NULL (random open port). host Character string specifying IP address listen . Defaults "127.0.0.1". launch.browser Logical, whether automatically open default web browser. Defaults interactive(). maxRequestSize Numeric maximum upload file size bytes. Defaults 10 * 1024^3 (10 GiB).

title: Launch Interactive scSimEval Benchmarking Studio — launch_scSimEval_app

title: Launch Interactive scSimEval Benchmarking Studio — launch_scSimEval_app
text: interactive scSimEvalStudio web application organizes single-cell multiomics simulation benchmarking 8 modular navigation tabs: Home: Executive KPI dashboard overview 8 canonical     evaluation categories (56 curated measures). Data Hub: Supports 4 data ingestion modes: (1) unimodal     scRNA-seq (44 active measures across 7 categories), (2) unimodal     scATAC-seq (38 active measures across 6 categories), (3) paired     unpaired Single-Cell Multiomics (56 measures across 8     categories), (4) pre-computed benchmark session archives     (.rds / .csv). Includes 1-click Oryza sativa Rice Bud     Glycine max Soybean Root empirical benchmarks 1-click     standalone HPC/Workstation R script generator. Comparative Bubble Matrix: Dual-encoded visual ranking figure     (scSimEval::plot_benchmark_bubble_matrix()) interactive     Fidelity Leaderboard (scSimEval::compute_method_leaderboard()). Visualizations: Eight diagnostic sub-panels (Evaluation     Summary, Distribution QC across 18 empirical properties,     Metric Heatmap, Metric Plots, PCA Ordination     anchored Ideal Reference Anchor \(\mathbf{1}\), MDS Metric     Space, Cell Embeddings [UMAP, t-SNE, PCA ASW ARI],     Scalability Benchmark [core_seconds MiB/core]),     equipped 25%–400% interactive step-zoom, drag--pan,     600% fullscreen lightbox viewer. Benchmark Results & Export: Reproducible .rds session     export, filterable DT master table (Score_Raw     direction-aligned Score \([0, 1]\)), multi-sheet Excel     (.xlsx) .csv exports. Help & Getting Started: Interactive workflow diagrams, S4     SingleCellExperiment preparation recipes, dynamic     BiocParallel multi-core scheduling guidelines. Logs: Real-time WebSocket diagnostic console streaming     INFO, NOTE, WARNING, ERROR,     SUCCESS events. Contact: Institutional attribution research team     directory Division Agricultural Bioinformatics, ICAR-IASRI,     New Delhi.
